definitions.explanation: A power tool that cuts with a spinning toothed disc, used mainly for making straight cuts in wood and building materials. Also written {丸鋸|まるのこ} or, in tool catalogs, {丸|まる}ノコ.

examples.english: I cut the board with a circular saw.

examples.japanese: {丸|まる}のこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧メガネ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Always wear safety glasses when using a circular saw.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っすぐ⟦{切|き}りたい→切る：02693_kiru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、のこぎり⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{丸|まる}のこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}くて→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: For a straight cut, a circular saw is faster and cleaner than a handsaw.

examples.japanese: ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ホームセンター→ホームセンター：11152_hoomusentaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{丸|まる}のこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りて→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: To build the shelf, I had the wood cut with a circular saw rented at the home center.

notes:
Written several ways — {丸|まる}のこ, {丸鋸|まるのこ}, and {丸|まる}ノコ — with the mixed spellings all read the same. The word covers both handheld saws and bench-mounted models.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸|まる}のこ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut with a circular saw
- {丸|まる}のこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧: the circular saw blade
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{丸|まる}のこ: electric circular saw

SIMILAR WORDS:
- のこぎり: handsaw — manual, with a straight blade
- ⟦チェーンソー→チェーンソー：30211_cheensoo⟧: chainsaw — for felling trees and cutting logs, not straight boards
